jobs.title: [self-heal] bm-a 分叉收口（reset 到 origin/main，先留备份分支）
jobs.cmd: git -C . branch -f backup/bm-a-20261111 HEAD && git -C . reset --hard origin/main && git -C . log -1 --oneline > cph4/fleet/reports/node-sync-bm-a-20261111.md

jobs.title: [verify] bm-a 自证图标是否真出图（SW/*/icon_512.png）
jobs.cmd: python -c "import glob,os,time;fs=glob.glob('软著申请材料/**/icon_512.png',recursive=True);print('icons=%d'%len(fs));[print('  %s %.1fh %dB'%(p,(time.time()-os.path.getmtime(p))/3600,os.path.getsize(p))) for p in sorted(fs,key=os.path.getmtime)[-12:]]" > cph4/fleet/reports/verify-icons-bma.txt 2>&1

jobs.title: [peer-heal] bm-a 用 WinRM 替 bm-c 收口
jobs.cmd: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$e=$null; try { Invoke-Command -ComputerName 100.123.74.104 -ScriptBlock { Set-Location 'K:\Fluxgroup\FluxGroup'; git fetch origin --prune; git branch -f backup/bm-c-20261111 HEAD 2>$null; git reset --hard origin/main; git log -1 --oneline } -ErrorAction Stop } catch { $e=$_.Exception.Message }; 'winrm_err='+$e | Out-File -Encoding utf8 cph4/fleet/reports/peer-sync-bm-c-20261111.md"
